notes: Second-schema validation set, frozen 2026-10-04 before any live run. Never tune prompts, guards or the catalog on these cases; add new cases instead. Reference SQL runs against data/northwind.duckdb (python -m secure_query.examples.load_northwind).

cases.question: How many customers are based in Germany?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customers WHERE Country = 'Germany'

cases.question: How many products do we sell?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products

cases.question: How many products have been discontinued?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = '1'

cases.question: What is the average freight cost per order?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(Freight) FROM Orders

cases.question: What is the highest freight charge on a single order?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(Freight) FROM Orders

cases.question: What is the total freight on orders shipped to France?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(Freight) FROM Orders WHERE ShipCountry = 'France'

cases.question: How many orders have not shipped yet?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders WHERE ShippedDate IS NULL

cases.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate >= '2017-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2018-01-01'

cases.question: How many employees are based in the UK?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employees WHERE Country = 'UK'

cases.question: How many different countries have we shipped orders to?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ShipCountry) FROM Orders

cases.question: How many products have a unit price above 50?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE UnitPrice > 50

cases.question: How many products are in each category?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, COUNT(*) FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many orders did each shipper carry?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, COUNT(*) FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON o.ShipVia = s.ShipperID GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What is the total freight by shipper?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, SUM(o.Freight) FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON o.ShipVia = s.ShipperID GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many units have been sold in each category?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many units are in stock for each category?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(p.UnitsInStock) FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many territories are in each region?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.RegionDescription, COUNT(*) FROM Territories t JOIN Regions r ON t.RegionID = r.RegionID GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many suppliers are there in each country?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Suppliers GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many orders were placed each year?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', OrderDate), COUNT(*) FROM Orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS units FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which employee handled the most orders?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.LastName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which 3 countries were the most orders shipped to?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ShipCountry, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which customer placed the most orders?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CompanyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many products are in the Seafood category?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE c.CategoryName = 'Seafood'

cases.question: What is the average unit price of products in the Beverages category?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(p.UnitPrice) FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE c.CategoryName = 'Beverages'

cases.question: Which customers have placed more than 200 orders?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CompanyName, COUNT(*) FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 200

cases.question: How many orders placed in 2016 were carried by Speedy Express?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON o.ShipVia = s.ShipperID WHERE s.CompanyName = 'Speedy Express' AND o.OrderDate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2017-01-01'

cases.question: How many units of Chai have been sold?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE p.ProductName = 'Chai'
